day_split_policy: Exercise-boundary split. Day 1 runs from chapter start to the first exercise heading. Then each day runs from the current exercise heading to the next exercise heading. The final day runs from the last exercise heading to chapter end. If an exercise heading is immediately followed by another exercise heading, the followed-up exercise is merged into the same day. Because only page ranges are stored, exercise boundary pages intentionally overlap between adjacent days.

Exercise headings that start within 1 printed page are merged into one day.
